data.name: Boston Tour for Families & Kids
data.headline: Designed for kids! • 4 Hours • Private tour • Up to 6 people
data.description:
##View photos, complete details, availability, and more on this tour's page: [Official Tour Listing](https://www.bostonhiddengems.com/tours/families-and-kids-boston-tour)

##Details
- 4 hours
- Max of 6 people per tour. More than 6? Contact us!
- Pickup at location of your choice

##About
Spend a fun day in Boston learning about history and exploring all the fun attractions! The tour is designed to be fun for the whole family! We have quizzes, we have scavenger hunts, we have prizes, and we have interactive stops so kids can run off some energy! On this tour you will see the key historical sites of Boston, including:
- Old North Church
- Public Garden, Make Way for the Ducklings statue
- Bunker Hill Monument (optionally, when admission hours allow, we can climb the 294 steps to the top of the monument)
- Tour the USS Constitution (when opening hours allow)
- Visit Fort Independence located on Castle Island (optionally dip your feet in the Boston Harbor)

##Included
Private vehicle for groups of 6 or less

##Not Included
Gratuities

##What to bring
Comfortable Clothes & Shoes
Money for snacks and souvenirs

##Note
Per Massachusetts law: "All children riding in passenger motor vehicles must be in a federally approved child passenger restraint that is properly fastened and secured according to the manufacturer's instructions until they are 8 years old OR over 57 inches tall." We do not provide child seats, please bring age appropriate car seats for kids who do not meet these criteria. We will not be able to do the tour if you do not have child seats for everyone that needs one. A refund will not be issued the day of the tour due to lack of proper car seats. All children must be registered as separate tour guests.
data.cancellation_summary: 14+ days prior 100%; 7-14 days prior 50%; no refund within 7 days
data.cancellation_notes:
- You will receive a full refund if you cancel at least 14 days before your tour 
- You will receive a 50% refund if you cancel at least 7 days before your tour
- No refunds within 7 days, but we will give you a 50% off coupon to book a new slot
